      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Release note updates following a code change do not qualify for membership under the documentation rubric."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes argument handling in src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp for createrawtransaction and createpsbt, enforcing standard RPC deprecation behavior via -deprecatedrpc=bip125.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Enforces RPC deprecation discipline for obsolete bip125 arguments across transaction creation RPCs following network-wide full-RBF defaults. While breaking callers who still pass replaceable unless the deprecated flag is used, deprecating redundant parameters is standard API hygiene and reasonably deferrable."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "The minor five-line edit to src/util/rbf.h is incidental support for the RPC deprecation check rather than a change to shared utility infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Incidental changes to utility headers in service of RPC parameter deprecation do not make the PR a utility change."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Wallet label and modifications to src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp and src/wallet/spend.cpp deprecating the replaceable parameter across wallet spend RPCs.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Deprecates redundant opt-in replaceability parameters across wallet transaction and PSBT creation methods as transactions are replaceable by default since v28. This provides valuable cleanup and unblocks eventual code removal (#32661), but does not affect fund safety or core wallet mechanics."
    }
